description.en: Granny Maggie knits jumpers for the whole dale and knows what everyone wears and looks like: a beard or a moustache, curly or straight hair, freckles, a waterproof for the fells, a cardigan for the evening, and a pocket for everything.
description.sl: Babica Maggie plete puloverje za vso dolino in ve, kaj kdo nosi in kako je videti: brada ali brki, kodrasti ali ravni lasje, pege, nepremočljiva jakna za hribe, jopica za večer in žep za vse.
description.it: Nonna Maggie fa maglioni per tutta la valle e sa che cosa indossa e com'è ognuno: barba o baffi, capelli ricci o lisci, lentiggini, una giacca impermeabile per i monti, un cardigan per la sera e una tasca per ogni cosa.
description.de: Oma Maggie strickt Pullover für das ganze Tal und weiß, was jeder trägt und wie er aussieht: Bart oder Schnurrbart, lockige oder glatte Haare, Sommersprossen, eine Regenjacke für die Berge, eine Strickjacke für den Abend und eine Tasche für alles.

words.example_en: Old Wilf has a long white beard.
words.example_sl: Stari Wilf ima dolgo belo brado.
words.example_it: Il vecchio Wilf ha una lunga barba bianca.
words.example_de: Der alte Wilf hat einen langen weißen Bart.

words.example_en: Mr Tyson's moustache is grey, but his hair is still dark.
words.example_sl: Brki gospoda Tysona so sivi, lasje pa so še temni.
words.example_it: I baffi del signor Tyson sono grigi, ma i capelli sono ancora scuri.
words.example_de: Mr Tysons Schnurrbart ist grau, aber sein Haar ist noch dunkel.

words.example_en: Poppy has curly red hair like her granny.
words.example_sl: Poppy ima kodraste rdeče lase kot babica.
words.example_it: Poppy ha i capelli rossi e ricci come la nonna.
words.example_de: Poppy hat lockiges rotes Haar wie ihre Oma.

words.example_en: Her hair is long and straight.
words.example_sl: Njeni lasje so dolgi in nekodravi.
words.example_it: Ha i capelli lunghi e lisci.
words.example_de: Ihr Haar ist lang und nicht gelockt.
words.note: Straight is also not bent: a straight line, and straight on: don't turn.
words.note_sl: Straight je tudi raven kot črta: a straight line; straight on: naravnost.
words.note_it: Straight vuol dire anche dritto: a straight line; straight on: sempre dritto.
words.note_de: Straight heißt auch gerade: a straight line; straight on: geradeaus.

words.example_en: Mr Dixon went bald at thirty, so he always wears a cap.
words.example_sl: Gospod Dixon je pri tridesetih oplešavel, zato vedno nosi kapo.
words.example_it: Il signor Dixon è diventato calvo a trent'anni, perciò porta sempre il berretto.
words.example_de: Mr Dixon war mit dreißig glatzköpfig, darum trägt er immer eine Mütze.

words.example_en: Maggie says every wrinkle is a story.
words.example_sl: Maggie pravi, da je vsaka guba zgodba.
words.example_it: Maggie dice che ogni ruga è una storia.
words.example_de: Maggie sagt, jede Falte ist eine Geschichte.

words.example_en: In summer Harry's face is covered in freckles.
words.example_sl: Poleti ima Harry obraz poln peg.
words.example_it: D'estate Harry ha la faccia piena di lentiggini.
words.example_de: Im Sommer ist Harrys Gesicht voller Sommersprossen.

words.example_en: Jack is tall and slim from all the walking.
words.example_sl: Jack je visok in vitek od vse hoje.
words.example_it: Jack è alto e magro per tutto il camminare.
words.example_de: Jack ist groß und schlank vom vielen Gehen.
words.note: Slim and thin are polite; skinny is very thin, a little rude.
words.note_sl: Slim in thin sta vljudna; skinny je presuh, malo nevljudno.
words.note_it: Slim e thin sono cortesi; skinny è magrissimo, un po' scortese.
words.note_de: Slim und thin sind höflich; skinny ist sehr dünn, etwas unhöflich.

words.example_en: The new teacher is a fair-haired woman from Carlisle.
words.example_sl: Nova učiteljica je svetlolasa ženska iz Carlisla.
words.example_it: La nuova maestra è una donna bionda di Carlisle.
words.example_de: Die neue Lehrerin ist eine blonde Frau aus Carlisle.

words.example_en: Both his children are dark-haired, like their mother.
words.example_sl: Oba njegova otroka sta temnolasa, kot mati.
words.example_it: Entrambi i suoi figli sono mori, come la madre.
words.example_de: Beide Kinder sind dunkelhaarig, wie ihre Mutter.

words.example_en: You should wear good boots on the fells.
words.example_sl: V hribih bi moral imeti obute dobre čevlje.
words.example_it: Sui monti dovresti indossare buoni scarponi.
words.example_de: In den Bergen solltest du gute Stiefel anhaben.
words.note: Wear, wore, worn. You wear clothes; you carry a bag.
words.note_sl: Wear, wore, worn. Wear je za oblačila; carry za torbo.
words.note_it: Wear, wore, worn. Wear per i vestiti; carry per una borsa.
words.note_de: Wear, wore, worn. Wear für Kleidung; carry für eine Tasche.

words.example_en: Alfie looks just like his grandad.
words.example_sl: Alfie je čisto podoben dedku.
words.example_it: Alfie assomiglia tantissimo al nonno.
words.example_de: Alfie sieht genau aus wie sein Opa.
words.note: What does she look like? asks about her face and hair; What is she like? about her character.
words.note_sl: What does she look like? sprašuje po videzu; What is she like? po značaju.
words.note_it: What does she look like? chiede dell'aspetto; What is she like? del carattere.
words.note_de: What does she look like? fragt nach dem Aussehen; What is she like? nach dem Charakter.

words.example_en: Maggie knitted me a jumper from Herdwick wool.
words.example_sl: Maggie mi je spletla pulover iz volne ovac herdwick.
words.example_it: Maggie mi ha fatto un maglione di lana Herdwick.
words.example_de: Maggie hat mir einen Pullover aus Herdwick-Wolle gestrickt.

words.example_en: Edna always has a cardigan over her shoulders, even in July.
words.example_sl: Edna ima vedno jopico čez ramena, celo julija.
words.example_it: Edna ha sempre un cardigan sulle spalle, anche a luglio.
words.example_de: Edna hat immer eine Strickjacke um die Schultern, sogar im Juli.

words.example_en: Never go up a fell without a waterproof.
words.example_sl: Nikoli ne pojdi v hrib brez nepremočljive jakne.
words.example_it: Non salire mai su un monte senza giacca impermeabile.
words.example_de: Geh nie ohne Regenjacke auf einen Berg.
words.note: Waterproof is also an adjective: waterproof boots.
words.note_sl: Waterproof je tudi pridevnik: waterproof boots (nepremočljivi čevlji).
words.note_it: Waterproof è anche aggettivo: waterproof boots.
words.note_de: Waterproof ist auch ein Adjektiv: waterproof boots.

words.example_en: I've lost a glove somewhere on Skiddaw.
words.example_sl: Nekje na Skiddawu sem izgubil rokavico.
words.example_it: Ho perso un guanto da qualche parte sullo Skiddaw.
words.example_de: Ich habe irgendwo am Skiddaw einen Handschuh verloren.

words.example_en: Your trousers are soaked, change before you catch a cold.
words.example_sl: Hlače so ti premočene, preobleci se, preden se prehladiš.
words.example_it: Hai i pantaloni fradici, cambiati prima di prendere il raffreddore.
words.example_de: Deine Hose ist klatschnass, zieh dich um, bevor du dich erkältest.
words.note: Trousers is plural: a pair of trousers. In America pants; in Britain pants are underwear!
words.note_sl: Trousers je v množini: a pair of trousers. V Ameriki pants; v Britaniji so pants spodnjice!
words.note_it: Trousers è plurale: a pair of trousers. In America pants; in Gran Bretagna pants sono le mutande!
words.note_de: Trousers ist Plural: a pair of trousers. Amerikanisch pants; britisch sind pants Unterhosen!

words.example_en: The Rush Maidens wear white skirts in the procession.
words.example_sl: Dekleta s ločjem v procesiji nosijo bela krila.
words.example_it: Le fanciulle dei giunchi portano gonne bianche nella processione.
words.example_de: Die Binsenmädchen tragen bei der Prozession weiße Röcke.

words.example_en: Harry wears shorts all year round, even in the snow.
words.example_sl: Harry nosi kratke hlače vse leto, celo v snegu.
words.example_it: Harry porta i pantaloncini tutto l'anno, anche con la neve.
words.example_de: Harry trägt das ganze Jahr kurze Hosen, sogar im Schnee.

words.example_en: Wear thick tights under your skirt, it's cold in church.
words.example_sl: Pod krilo obleci debele hlačne nogavice, v cerkvi je mraz.
words.example_it: Metti dei collant pesanti sotto la gonna, in chiesa fa freddo.
words.example_de: Zieh eine dicke Strumpfhose unter den Rock, in der Kirche ist es kalt.

words.example_en: These trousers are too big: I need a belt.
words.example_sl: Te hlače so prevelike: potrebujem pas.
words.example_it: Questi pantaloni sono troppo grandi: mi serve una cintura.
words.example_de: Die Hose ist zu groß: Ich brauche einen Gürtel.

words.example_en: Jack always has a dog biscuit in his pocket.
words.example_sl: Jack ima v žepu vedno pasji piškot.
words.example_it: Jack ha sempre un biscotto per cani in tasca.
words.example_de: Jack hat immer einen Hundekeks in der Tasche.

words.example_en: The zip on my jacket is broken again.
words.example_sl: Zadrga na jakni je spet pokvarjena.
words.example_it: La cerniera della giacca è di nuovo rotta.
words.example_de: Der Reißverschluss meiner Jacke ist schon wieder kaputt.

words.example_en: Tie your shoelaces before you go down the scree!
words.example_sl: Zaveži si vezalke, preden greš po melišču navzdol!
words.example_it: Allaccia i lacci prima di scendere per il ghiaione!
words.example_de: Bind deine Schnürsenkel zu, bevor du das Geröll hinuntergehst!
